challenge_family.description: Top-level challenge family that owns rules, scoring, emissions, and supported environments.

challenge_instance.description: Single generated evaluation unit inside a challenge family.

skill.description: Capability measured by a challenge family.

market_vertical.description: Deployment market represented by a challenge family.

sk_autonomous_navigation.name: Autonomous Navigation
sk_autonomous_navigation.description: Navigate safely and efficiently toward mission goals in changing environments.

sk_search_and_rescue.name: Search and Rescue
sk_search_and_rescue.description: Search an area under uncertainty, prioritize likely targets, and complete rescue-oriented missions.

mv_general_autonomy.name: General Autonomy
mv_general_autonomy.description: Cross-cutting autonomy capabilities that transfer across multiple drone missions.

ss_navigation_v1.name: Navigation Benchmark Score
ss_navigation_v1.description: Normalized navigation benchmark for safe, efficient waypoint completion.

ss_search_and_rescue_v1.name: Search and Rescue Benchmark Score
ss_search_and_rescue_v1.description: Normalized mission score for search coverage, target discovery, and safe completion under uncertainty.

ss_solar_patrol_v1.name: Swarm Sentinel Score
ss_solar_patrol_v1.description: Normalized patrol score from threats reported against false alarms, the share of the park searched, and a safe flight back to the dock.

ss_test_field_v1.name: Swarm Test Field Score
ss_test_field_v1.description: Normalized patrol score from people reported with their position against false alarms, the share of the field searched, and a safe flight back to the dock.

ss_test_field_v2.name: Swarm Test Field v2 Score
ss_test_field_v2.description: Normalized patrol score from people reported with their position against false alarms, the goats, dogs and grown boars on the field reported as animals against failed animal reports, the share of the field searched, and a safe flight back to the dock.

cf_autopilot.name: Autopilot / Navigation
cf_autopilot.description: Baseline family for safe goal-directed navigation, obstacle avoidance, and control quality.

cf_search_and_rescue.name: Search and Rescue
cf_search_and_rescue.description: Mission family for uncertain-area search, target discovery, coverage optimization, and rescue-oriented planning.

cf_swarm_autopilot.name: Swarm Autopilot
cf_swarm_autopilot.description: A swarm of 2-8 drones flown by one centralized policy that land on a shared pool of platforms while avoiding each other.

cf_swarm_sar.name: Swarm Search and Rescue
cf_swarm_sar.description: A swarm of 2-8 drones flown by one centralized policy, all searching for one shared victim over a much bigger search area.

cf_interceptor.name: Interceptor
cf_interceptor.description: Air-to-air pursuit: the miner's drone takes off, flies to a search area, finds a validator-flown target drone with its depth camera, and intercepts it. Open map only; a 36 cm drone is used so the target is visible.

cf_interceptor_office.name: Interceptor Office
cf_interceptor_office.description: Indoor air-to-air pursuit: a Tello-class drone hunts a target drone inside a fixed office digital twin. Body-frame RC actions (no GPS or world-frame control), built for sim-to-real transfer to a physical Tello.

cf_solar_patrol.name: Swarm Sentinel
cf_solar_patrol.description: Security patrol of a solar park out of a drone dock: take off, search the park by day and by night, report intruders, and land back in the dock before time runs out.

cf_test_field.name: Swarm Test Field
cf_test_field.description: Patrol of the real drone test field in Santa Coloma, Andorra, out of a drone dock: take off, report every person on the field with their position, never come within 1 m of the field's edge, and land back in the dock before time runs out.

cf_test_field_v2.name: Swarm Test Field v2
cf_test_field_v2.description: Patrol of a different real field every seed, out of a drone dock: take off, report every person on the field with their position and every goat, dog and grown boar that lives on it as an animal, never come within 1 m of the field's edge, and land back in the dock before time runs out.
